buyer.name.label: Buyer
buyer.name.meaning: The public body that is paying for this purchase.

tender.title.label: What is being bought
tender.title.meaning: The goods, works or services the buyer asked for.

awards[0].value.amount.label: Value (KES)
awards[0].value.amount.meaning: The amount the buyer agreed to pay the winning supplier.

tender.value.amount.label: Estimated value (KES)
tender.value.amount.meaning: What the buyer expected to spend before bids came in.

tender.procurementMethod.label: Method
tender.procurementMethod.meaning: How suppliers were invited: open to all, limited to a few, or direct to one.

date.label: Published
date.meaning: When this version of the record was published on the portal.

tender.tenderPeriod.label: Tender period
tender.tenderPeriod.meaning: The window during which suppliers could submit bids.

awards[0].date.label: Award date
awards[0].date.meaning: When the buyer decided who won.

awards[0].suppliers.label: Supplier
awards[0].suppliers.meaning: The company or person chosen to deliver.

tender.status.label: Status
tender.status.meaning: Where the process stands: planned, active, complete, cancelled or unsuccessful.
